description:
Welcome to the enchanted land of Esperia! Play as the legendary mage Merlin and explore a beautifully illustrated storybook world. Outsmart your foes in strategic card battles and uncover the secrets of this world alongside other heroes.

1,000 Recruits | Claim Launch Heroes
Log in and claim all launch heroes!
Begin your journey with your dream formation!

Play Smart | Adapt Formations for Different Strategies
Power isn't everything! It's possible to defeat stronger opponents with your wit and strategy!
Deploy heroes from six classes, position them strategically, and time their ultimates to overcome your enemies! Use faction buffs, terrain, and battle mechanics to your advantage!

Shared Levels | Deploy New Heroes Immediately
Equipment and levels are shared across heroes. No more grinding!
Feel free to try out different formations at zero cost!

100 Heroes | Original and Unique Designs
Meet 100 heroes from seven factions!
Witness the Lightbearers, who carry the pride of humanity. Watch the Wilders flourish at the heart of their forest. Observe how the Maulers survive against all odds through sheer strength. The Graveborn legions are amassing, and the eternal clash between the Celestials and the Hypogeans rages on. And then there are the Dimensional heroes, visiting from distant worlds. Discover their skills and captivating backstories.

Excellent Graphics | Immersive, Vast Magical World
Explore the storybook-style magical world, where every detail is meticulously crafted.
Roam through forests and mountains, using vines and tree stumps to bridge waterfalls and rivers as you take in the stunning scenery. Along the way, enjoy a range of interactive experiences, such as petting stray cats on the streets, going ice-skating, and having snowball fights... Every moment is full of surprises!

Epic Adventures | Uncover Secrets as Magister Merlin
A new adventure awaits with every season!
Long ago, the seed of life drifted to Esperia from the stars and took root, giving birth to a land of wonder. However, as the gods fell during a chaotic war, six great factions emerged, each vying for power and dominance. Remember, only you can guide heroes to pull ""the sword from the stone"" and learn the truth about the world.

Collect Resources Quickly | Level Up Fast
Say goodbye to grinding for resources. Collect rewards effortlessly with our auto-battle and AFK features. Continue gathering resources even while you're sleeping.
Enjoy hassle-free resource collection and smooth, rewarding progression!

description: JOIN US ON DISOCRD     About the Game        Brand-New Season “Afterlight” Launches July 16!    The Night Watch Begins — Rewards Await   The new Season arrives with a full lineup of events. Log in daily to claim a Legendary Battle Pactspirit Selection Pack, and from the second week on, checking in also earns you a 10x Battle Pactspirit draw. Complete Season event and objective quests for even more rewards, including rare Season Drop Pactspirits, Pactspirit Crystals, Exclusive Weapon Appearances, Activation Medium: Motionless, and a generous supply of Tax Vouchers!   Seasonal Mechanic: Afterlight   As night falls, the Guiding Lantern flickers to life. Purify the restless Wraiths gathering along the procession's path and collect scattered relics and high-value loot. Watch for golden reward monsters, special coffins, revived Wraiths, and mysterious bosses: surprise encounters that make every run more thrilling and more rewarding!   New Hero Trait: Dance of the Deep   Tide Whisper Selena arrives with the brand-new Hero Trait Dance of the Deep. Built around Terra skills, her flowing combat rhythm lets the Crimson Tide move with her every step, opening fresh build possibilities amid dazzling, deadly spins!   New Progression: Nether King's Divinity   Nether King's Divinity introduces a new kind of Divinity Slate. Brand your Divine Remnants to cultivate unique Divinity forms, then harness special effects like Judgment, Contamination, and Banishment to discover new build paths and craft slate combinations all your own!   New Challenge: Divine Ascent   The all-new challenge mode Divine Ascent is here! Climb ever-higher floors against a tense three-minute timer, defeat floor bosses, clear random events, and claim dense first-clear rewards. Then carve your name into both the First Clear Rankings and the Infinity Rankings!   System & Visual Upgrades Across the Board   Lunaria goes core, now faster and easier to build around. Renewed Memory becomes permanent in streamlined form, and the Dream Interpretation system has been retired in favor of a reworked gear affix experience. Quality-of-life upgrades arrive in force: Trade House price checks, Quick Buy, One-Tap skill leveling, mouse cursor size settings, and separate brightness and transparency controls for effects. Ember's Rest, the Netherrealm Device, select hero models, and gear icons have all received visual upgrades, delivering a smoother, more immersive new Season experience!             FAST & THRILLING Battles  With no stamina and no cooldowns, smash down incoming waves with melee attacks, blast off magical explosions and draining pools, or snipe down ranged enemies. Grind with your own battle style!            Collect ENDLESS Loot  Unlimited drops from battles to upgrade build styles and establish your own collection. Prove your grind power by showing off in the in-game free market.            Build UNLIMITED Playstyles  With unique heroes, 24 talent tabs, 200+ legendary gears, 240+ powerful skills, Try out infinite playstyles or strategic possibilities on hero builds. Build your very own hero!            Trade AT WILL  Utilize the Trade house to be a part of a booming economy with an infinite amount of hero builds to trade. One hunter's trash might be another hunter's treasure!
